conviction_note: Nothing unpriced found: H1 should land at or a little above a conservative company plan (Q1 progress 38.1% against plan versus 49.6% a year earlier, so a much smaller beat than last year's +25%, which sold off 4.67%), the full-year plan is almost always held at H1, and the dividend was already raised in July. So p_up 48 on a scale of 2.6 gives -0.1, and the findings sum to -0.2, mostly small known-negative items cut toward zero under rule 1.
bar: Company H1 plan (FY3/27 4-9月): sales 15,082m, OP 1,419m, ordinary 1,418m, net 1,041m; FY OP 3,850m, dividend 80 yen. Source: Q1 決算短信 2026-07-28 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260724599580.pdf . There is no analyst consensus (kabuyoho shows no consensus: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTop?bcode=3771) and 四季報 could not be reached, so the bar is the company plan only and every size here is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register (baseline, as of 2026-10-27): 1.01% from one seller, up 0.10pt from 0.91%, so small and building slightly. 信用倍率 34.1x (baseline and kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3771, 2026-10-28), i.e. leveraged retail heavily long: this is the setup where a disappointment still finds sellers. Fidelity group holding has hovered at the 10% line (10.0% to 9.86% on 2026-08-31, back to 10.0% on 2026-09-15, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3771&b=n202609240941), which is churn and not a signal. No options, so no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.56.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit should land near the 1,419m plan, at most a few percent above it: Q1 OP 540m is 38.1% of the H1 plan against 49.6% at the same point last year (611/1,231), when H1 then beat plan by 25%. Q2 needs 879m to hit plan, against 918m in Q2 last year. No 業績予想の修正 has been filed before the print (the company did pre-release a +48% H1 beat on 2023-10-23), so the beat is under the 30% disclosure threshold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 FY3/26 beat its plan by 25% with FY held and the stock fell 4.67% the next session (2025-10-29); H1 FY3/25 rose 2.8% (2024-10-30). Yahoo daily closes https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3771.T?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The progress rate can be computed from the July 短信, and kabutan printed it (38.1% vs 5-year average 38.8%). The only thing that is not in the wire copy is the comparison with last year's 49.6% progress against plan, which says a smaller beat than last year. If the market expected a repeat of last year's beat, the stock would not be 10% below where it sat into last year's H1 print (2,186 on 2025-10-28 vs 1,961 now).
findings.independence: Last year's H1 numbers come from a different kabutan article (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3771&b=k202510280051); the revision record (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3771) gives the 2023 pre-release. All of it is the company's own disclosure.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 3,850m, +11%) will very likely be held at this print: the revision record shows the company revises in January or April, never at H1 unless forced (2023's forced pre-release was H1 only). A hold leaves a back-loaded plan where H2 OP must rise about 24.6% YoY (2,431m vs 1,951m) after a down H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY plan held at H1 in 2024 and 2025: +2.8% and -4.67% the next sessions. Mixed, no consistent sign.
findings.why_not_priced: A hold is the default the market expects, and that is why this is near zero. The back-loaded H2 can be worked out from the published H1 and FY plans. If holders were worried about it the stock would be lower than its pre-Q1 level; instead it is 6% above its July close (1,847 to 1,961).
findings.independence: Q1 短信 confirms the plan was unchanged at Q1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260724599580.pdf). The same company documents.

findings.finding: Q1 order intake fell 18.6% YoY (8,169m) and SI services orders fell 28.3% (3,122m) on fewer lump-sum projects from a main customer, while the order backlog was still +9.5% (7,533m). The H1 短信 will update this order table.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved case of the order table moving this stock. The Q1 print that first showed it rose 1.3% the next session (2026-07-29), but a dividend-policy change came out with it.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since July and it rose through it, so mostly priced. What is left is whether H1 orders confirm the drop. That is unknowable before the print, and with backlog +9.5% and sales +7%, a weak order line is not clearly a negative.

findings.finding: Shareholder returns: in July the company moved to a 50% payout target with progressive dividends for FY3/27-3/29 and raised the FY dividend from 70 to 80 yen. That is a 46.8% payout on plan EPS of 171, below the new target. If H1 beats, there is room for a further raise, but by habit the company raises at Q3 (January 2025 and January 2026) or Q1, not at H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Dividend raises at Q3 FY3/26 (-2.55%, 2026-02-02) and Q1 FY3/27 with the policy change (+1.3%, 2026-07-29). Raises have not been bought strongly.
findings.why_not_priced: The 80 yen is priced (yield 4.09% on kabutan). A further raise at H1 would break the company's habit, so the market gives it little weight. The small positive is that option: the payout gap to the 50% target is about 5.5 yen at plan EPS.
findings.independence: The revision record on https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3771 shows the timing pattern of the dividend raises (修 at 25/01, 26/01 and 26/07).

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely (the company revises in Jan/Apr; a hold is the default). Returns: dividend already raised to 80 in July under a 50%-payout progressive policy, so a further raise at H1 would break habit. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 was 38.1% of the H1 plan vs 49.6% last year and a 38.8% 5-year average on the actual-H1 basis, so H1 should be roughly in line, a small beat at most.
baseline_tension: Little tension. The findings are near zero and slightly negative, the priced lean is -0.56 (margin overhang at 34x) and the 20-day run-up is +4%. The strongest positive the release could carry, which I looked for, is an H1 beat of a conservatively set plan (the company's habit: +48% in 2023, +25% in 2025) plus a dividend top-up toward the 50% target. Last year's +25% beat was still sold 4.67%, so even that positive has a weak reaction record.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a progress rate anyone can compute from the last 短信, or on public series): halved the H1 progress finding (-0.3 to -0.15) and the Q1 order-intake finding (-0.3 to -0.15). p_up moved from 46 to 48.
Rule 1 / core 'inside guidance': the FY-hold finding goes from -0.2 to -0.1, because a hold is what the company's record makes the default.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension (a habitual H1 beat and a dividend top-up option) and confirmed I had looked for it. The capital-return finding stays at +0.2.
abs_move_pct unchanged at 2.6 (proxy 2.51, median of real post-release moves about 2.6). The scaled number goes from -0.21 to -0.10.
